newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita dropped to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita dropped to sell.

text.p: -- Robert Fleming said on Monday it had downgraded its rating for Brazilian stainless steelmaker Acesita SA to sell from hold.

-- In a report, analyst Raphael Biderman said the company's restructuring and capital expenditure program were "a race against time to reach economies of scale and enhanced cost competitiveness in order to counteract the decline of the global stainless steel market during 1997.
-- "However, we fear that the company is trying to do too many things at the same time."
-- The company reported an accumulated loss of $12.84 million in the first nine months of 1996. Gross margins in the third quarter fell to 5.1 percent from 7.8 percent in the second quarter.
